    • applyDamage

      public static void applyDamage(org.bukkit.inventory.EquipmentSlot _hand, org.bukkit.entity.Player _player)
      Apply damage for an item.

      Check if the item is not breakable, and if the item is 0 durability, it's remove item. This is used only when player is Bedrock and the plugin must manage event manually.

      Parameters:
      _hand - Hand used (to retrieve stack item for good hand).
      _player - Player.

    • readMaterial

      protected boolean readMaterial(LoggerDispatcher _logger, boolean _bSearchMaterialIfListEmpty, String _strKeyName, Map<String,Object> _mapItems, List<AMaterialManager.MaterialInformation> _lstMaterialsInformation, boolean _bIsEmptyAllowed, Function<AMaterialManager.MaterialInformation,Boolean> _lambdaIsMaterialInformationValid)
      Read material with extra information.
      Parameters:
      _logger - Wrap class to log to sender if provide from a command, used to write message to info logger.
      _bSearchMaterialIfListEmpty - If the list is empty, this allow to make search to all material allowed.
      _strKeyName - Key name to retrieve the list of materials information (name / regex and extra information).
      _mapItems - Map where to find information.
      _lstMaterialsInformation - Materials information list to fill.
      _bIsEmptyAllowed - If empty is not allowed, return false if the key doesn't exist, else just not fill _lstMaterialsInformation.
      _lambdaIsMaterialInformationValid - Lambda to check if the material information is valid for this search. If null all is allowed.
      Returns:
      true if no error, false else.

      protected Set<String> findRegions(LoggerDispatcher _logger, List<String> _listRegionsNames, Consumer<String> _lambdaInfoAdd, Consumer<String> _lambdaInfoInvalid)
      Get a list of regions names from a _listRegionsNames.

    • formatPlaceHolders

      public static com.sk89q.worldedit.util.formatting.text.Component formatPlaceHolders(String _strTemplateText, Map<String,com.sk89q.worldedit.util.formatting.text.Component> _mapPlaceholders)
      Transform a string with placeholders to WorldEdit Component.

      Replace each placeholder to a Component passed into parameter and apply a color based on legacy codes (§). Used to be able to crete message with translated strings.

      Parameters:
      _strTemplateText - Text template with colors, ex: "§cFill the <cauldron> with <material> is forbidden."
      _mapPlaceholders - Placeholders map, ex: "cauldron" -> TranslatableComponent.of(_block.getTranslationKey()).
      Returns:
      Component WorldEdit message ready to send.
